items.title: Thirst & Despair: Changai Toro Villagers Forced to Share Water with Livestock After Borehole Collapse
items.summary: Written by: Dawda Baldeh Residents of Changai Toro, in the Sami District of the Central River Region (CRR), are facing a severe water crisis following the breakdown of the village’s only borehole, leaving hundreds of people without access to safe drinking water and forcing wom...
